summary: Frontend-only retest of the 4-level client hierarchy (Grupo Económico → Marca → RIF → Sucursal) using Playwright as admin rgonzalez. All 3 retests pass. 1) QA4: a client with only RIF J999286397 and Nombre Jurídico (no grupo, no marca, no contact) saved with the toast 'Cliente creado exitosamente'. contact-full-name-0 has no required attribute, and POST /api/clients returned 200. 2) Selecting grupo ALKOSTO and saving without a marca correctly shows the validation toast. A normal click (no force) on client-marca-create-btn hits the button itself (elementFromPoint check) and opens brand-dialog with brand-group-select disabled and set to ALKOSTO. Saving 'TEST_QA4N Marca' returned POST /api/marcas 200, the marca was auto-selected in client-marca-select, and the client saved (200, marca_id set). 3) Editing an ALKOSTO client: client-inheritance-summary shows 9 rows in 2 columns, with no overlapping rows (bounding-box check) and no horizontal overflow. Smoke checks: /grupos-economicos expand ALKOSTO → brands → TEST brand → RIF works; /marcas brand-expand → RIF tree and RIF count (1) work. contact-select-modal and hierarchy-contact-picker were not re-smoked in this run (kept short as requested). All test data was deleted via API (both DELETE calls returned 200, follow-up GET returned 404).

integration_issues.issue: The client was saved with inherit_overrides=['segment'] although the user never touched Segmento. The default 'Pymes' form value is treated as an explicit override, so if the Marca/Grupo later defines a segment, this RIF will NOT inherit it. Suggest only counting segment as an override when the user actually changed it, or leaving it empty when a marca is chosen.

issues: The Marca select is narrow (~175px), so the placeholder 'Seleccione la marca (obligatoria)' truncates to 'Seleccione la ma...'. Cosmetic only.
Inheritance summary: the LevelTag wraps under the value, so row heights differ between the 2 columns. Readable and not overlapping.
